decks.notes: The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, focusing on dealing damage efficiently and consistently. The main concept of this deck is to focus on a fast-paced aggressive playstyle by using a combination of low-cost creatures, burn spells, and support cards to quickly deal damage to the opponent and seize control of the game. With a mix of powerful creatures like Marauding Mako and Vivi Ornitier, along with efficient removal spells like Abrade and Torch the Tower, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the match. Additionally, cards like Profit's Eidetic Memory and Agatha's Soul Cauldron provide card advantage and additional resources to stay ahead of the opponent.
